name: changelog-writer
description: Write a changelog or release notes from a list of commits or merged pull requests. Use when the user wants release notes drafted for publication.

name: customer-reply-drafter
description: Draft a friendly reply to a customer email or support ticket. Use when the user asks for a response to send to a customer.

name: status-report-builder
description: Turn a list of tasks and owners into a weekly status report with red/amber/green ratings. Use for team status reports.

name: sql-query-helper
description: Write, explain, and optimize SQL queries for PostgreSQL and SQLite. Use when the user asks about database queries.

name: pdf-form-filler
description: Fill in PDF forms from structured data and flatten the result. Use when the user wants a PDF form completed.

name: python-debugger
description: Diagnose Python tracebacks and propose minimal fixes. Use when the user shares a Python error.
